1229388891.description_en: The 2026 NIPA Integrated Program Briefing introduces a wide range of initiatives, including ICT Innovation Square, ICT Complex, and support for open-source AI development. It features in-depth discussions on ways to use and contribute to open source, policies supporting the use of AI semiconductors, and measures to close the regional AI gap. The briefing shows the government's firm commitment to securing future growth engines for the ICT industry.

1229388794.title_en: 2026 NIPA Program Announcements and Selection Process Guide
1229388794.description_en: A guide to the 2026 NIPA integrated program announcements and selection process. From announcement to final selection takes about 2.5 months, and the video explains in detail how to apply, required documents, evaluation criteria, and the appeals process. It also covers what to do if a system error occurs.

1229388698.title_en: Regional AI Innovation and Digital Transformation Strategy
1229388698.description_en: This video presents the strategy of the Regional AX Division for AI and digital innovation in the regions. Aiming to close service gaps and address population challenges, it builds a “playground” for AI and software companies. It covers innovation that combines region-specific industries with AI, large-scale R&D projects, and plans to extend the benefits of AX to underserved regions such as Chungnam, Gangwon, and Jeju.

1229388543.description_en: Presents the integrated policy directions for promoting the ICT industry in 2026. It introduces regulatory innovation through the regulatory sandbox, digital talent development, and a range of support programs for advancing AI technology. The policy supports the free testing of innovative ideas and technologies, with a focus on training the key talent who will lead the industries of the future.

1229388541.title_en: NIPA's 2026 Strategy for Becoming an AI Powerhouse
1229388541.description_en: At the 2026 NIPA Integrated Program Briefing, NIPA President Park Yun-kyu emphasized the dynamism of AI and, building on Korea's AI potential and the strengths of its semiconductor industry, expressed the government's commitment to making Korea a global AI powerhouse. NIPA will drive structural innovation across the AI ecosystem by strengthening core AI capabilities, launching new AI projects, spreading AI across the public and private sectors, and reforming evaluation to be more market-driven.

1229388407.description_en: This video presents the 2026 business directions for the information and communications technology (ICT) industry, explaining in detail the strategies for helping Korean companies expand overseas and attracting foreign companies to Korea. With a total budget of KRW 70 billion, it supports more than 250 companies in over 20 countries, focusing on global cooperation in artificial intelligence (AI) and on fostering startups. Through a variety of support programs, it aims to help companies grow and strengthen their global competitiveness.

1229388048.title_en: AI Technology Commercialization and Industrialization Strategy
1229388048.description_en: The AI Utilization Division pursues integrated project management and ecosystem building with the goal of commercializing and industrializing AI technology. In the public sector, it focuses on solving social problems and raising citizen satisfaction through the “Top 10 AI Projects for the People.” It also plans to promote the practical application and spread of AI through medical AI innovation and region-specific programs.

1229388044.description_en: The Software Convergence Division will lead service innovation through “Software Defined X (SDX)” by 2026. The video introduces a range of support measures, including flagship XaaS projects, support for open-source AI software development, and joint growth of AI and virtual convergence. It also strengthens the legal and institutional foundations of public software projects to promote the growth of the IT industry.

1229388041.title_en: 2026 NIPA Program Directions and AI Strategy
1229388041.description_en: Introduces NIPA's 2026 policy directions and program plans. Focusing on the growth of the AI and software industries, NIPA will work on business support, global expansion, talent development, regional integration, and regulatory improvement. In particular, it concentrates its budget on expanding AI infrastructure, developing K-AI models, and investing in AI semiconductors, with the goal of making Korea one of the AI G3 nations.

1229388040.title_en: Introduction to the AI Semiconductor Commercialization Support Program
1229388040.description_en: Introduces the government support program for commercializing AI semiconductors. Through comprehensive support spanning chipmakers, devices, AI models, and service companies, it strengthens the global competitiveness of Korea's NPU technology. It provides financial support and talent development across the entire value chain, from design and prototyping to mass production and overseas expansion.
